name: Fixer Adds Tags to Untagged Tests
task:
Fix the failing tests.

references/style-guide.md documents the test tagging conventions for this project. It explains that the preferred approach is Playwright's native `{ tag: [...] }` property, not putting tags back into the title string.

Broken selector: LoginPage.ts uses `[data-test="user-name"]` — the correct attribute is `[data-test="username"]`.

After fixing the selector, restore the test's metadata tags using the native property format (not the old title-string format).
passCriteria: Fixes the broken selector in LoginPage.ts (user-name → username)
After fixing the selector, adds { tag: ['@feature:auth', '@priority:...', '@test_type:...'] } to the previously untagged test using the native Playwright tag property
Uses the native tag property format from references/style-guide.md, not title-string format
failCriteria: Fixes the selector but leaves the test without tags
Adds tags back to the title string instead of using the native tag property
Only tags the test without fixing the selector (tests still fail)
Removes or rewrites the test assertion instead of fixing the selector

modifications.find: test('@auth @smoke @test_type:regression Valid user can login successfully'
